config.veinmine.title: Vein Mine Settings
config.veinmine.maxBlocks.tooltip: Maximum number of blocks to mine at once.
config.veinmine.damageTool.tooltip: Whether the tool should take damage for each mined block.
config.veinmine.shapeMode.tooltip: SHAPELESS: Identical blocks only. SHAPED: Rectangular prism of given dimensions.
config.veinmine.renderOutline.tooltip: Renders a preview of blocks that will be mined.
config.veinmine.directDrop.tooltip: Items drop directly into your inventory. Drops at feet if inventory is full.
config.veinmine.preventToolBreak.tooltip: Stops vein mining before the tool breaks, leaving it with 1 durability.
config.veinmine.hungerDrain.tooltip: Drains hunger proportionally to the number of blocks mined.
